subject: Michael Truell
heading: Michael Truell net worth
paragraph: Michael Truell's net worth is estimated at **$2.8 billion as of October 9, 2026**, according to [Forbes' wealth profile](https://www.forbes.com/profile/michael-truell/). His financial turning point was Cursor's [August 2026 acquisition by SpaceX](https://cursor.com/blog/joining-spacex); Forbes estimates each co-founder received about **$2.4 billion in SpaceX shares at closing**. That stock consideration is part of the wealth story, not an additional cash payout to add to the current estimate. His exact holdings, liabilities and present ownership percentage remain undisclosed in the reviewed records.
